AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Provides arithmetic, order-total, and fixed-rate currency-conversion functions. Operational Patterns: - calculateTotal processes all line items for one order in a single call. Constraints: - calculateTotal accepts non-negative whole Japanese-yen prices and non-negative quantities; discountPercent is 0 through 100 and defaults to 0. - convertCurrency accepts non-negative finite amounts and uses fixed demo rates: JPY=1, USD=100 JPY, EUR=200 JPY.
